tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Search Does It Work In guides and provider comparisons by query, country slug (e.g. "china", "japan", "hong-kong"), or topic ("esim", "vpn", "payments", "maps", "ai", "transit").

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Get full compatibility details for a path (e.g. "/china/esim", "/china/alipay", "/compare/airalo-vs-holafly-vs-saily"): official claim vs. verified reality, pre-departure steps, failure modes, recommended providers and FAQs.

tools.name: get_country
tools.description: Get the full compatibility status matrix, guides and recommended providers for a destination slug (e.g. "china", "hong-kong", "japan", "south-korea", "thailand", "vietnam", "indonesia", "turkey", "uae", "taiwan", "europe").

tools.name: list_providers
tools.description: List tested eSIM, VPN, multi-currency payment and travel booking providers with starting prices, direct referral URLs, promo codes and summary notes.

tools.name: list_referrals
tools.description: List active travel eSIM and booking referral codes and direct partner links with plain-English disclosures of what you get and what Does It Work In earns.

tools.name: report_outdated_info
tools.description: Submit a field report if a carrier rule, app status, payment limit or provider price has changed.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_providers · Public sink: report_outdated_info.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_providers · Public sink: report_outdated_info

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_providers" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "List tested eSIM, VPN, multi-currency payment and travel booking providers with starting prices and summary notes." → after: "List tested eSIM, VPN, multi-currency payment and travel booking providers with starting prices, direct referral URLs, promo codes and summary notes."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
